parameters.query:
SELECT CASE WHEN value ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN value::bigint ELSE 0 END AS tg_offset
FROM bot_state WHERE key = 'tg_offset';
UPDATE bot_state SET value = '{{ Math.max(...$json.result.map(u => u.update_id)) + 1 }}' WHERE key = 'tg_offset';

UPDATE targets SET
  status = CASE $1 WHEN 'approve' THEN 'queued' WHEN 'skip' THEN 'skipped' ELSE 'email_found' END,
  approved_at = CASE WHEN $1 = 'approve' THEN now() ELSE approved_at END,
  attempts = attempts + CASE WHEN $1 = 'redo' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
WHERE id = $2 AND applicant_id = $3 AND status = 'awaiting_approval'
RETURNING company, status;

INSERT INTO targets (applicant_id, company, email, email_domain, address, postcity, contact, hr_email)
VALUES ($1, btrim(convert_from(decode($2, 'base64'), 'UTF8')), $3, $4, NULLIF(btrim(convert_from(decode($5, 'base64'), 'UTF8')), ''), NULLIF(btrim(convert_from(decode($6, 'base64'), 'UTF8')), ''), NULLIF(btrim(convert_from(decode($7, 'base64'), 'UTF8')), ''), NULLIF(btrim(convert_from(decode($8, 'base64'), 'UTF8')), ''))
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

SELECT step, data::text AS data FROM conversations WHERE chat_id = $1;

INSERT INTO conversations (chat_id, step, data, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, convert_from(decode($3, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb, now())
ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE SET step = EXCLUDED.step, data = EXCLUDED.data, updated_at = now()
RETURNING step;
